title: Open Source Libs
tagline: abap2UI5 sample apps that put eleven open-source ABAP libraries to work in the browser.
summary: Each package in src/ is one abap2UI5 app for one community library: statistics, Excel, JSON, OpenAPI, diffs, PDF and Word documents, test data and validation. The libraries are installed as dependencies and never copied. It is for ABAP developers who want to see and try a library on their own system before they use it, for library authors who want to show their library at work and for abap2UI5 developers looking for complete apps to learn from.
features: Eleven sample apps, one package per library, e.g. z2ui5_cl_osl_abap2xlsx
Libraries: abap-tbox-stats, abap2xlsx, abap_fm_json, abap-openapi, ABAP Diff3
Also JSON2ABAPType, abap-fm-logger, zcl_pdf, zcl_docx, abapFaker, abap-data-validator
Each package needs only abap2UI5 and its own library
Statistics charts of tbox-stats use sap.viz and need SAPUI5 instead of OpenUI5
requirements: Standard ABAP: S/4 Private Cloud, On-Premise or SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP 7.50 or higher
ABAP Cloud: no (most libraries use APIs not released for ABAP Cloud)
The library of each sample you want to run
SAPUI5 bootstrap (not OpenUI5) for the tbox-stats charts in src/01

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: abap2UI5, the library of each sample you want to run, then this repository (branch main)
abap_fm_json brings the authorization object Z_JSON; JSON2ABAPType needs its whole repository; abap-data-validator: install branch master; zcl_docx: install the whole package
For tbox-stats switch the bootstrap to SAPUI5 in the abap2UI5 user exit (cs_config-src)

usage:
METHOD z2ui5_if_ui5_exit~set_config_http_get.
  " or the SAPUI5 of the system: /sap/public/bc/ui5_ui5/resources/sap-ui-core.js
  cs_config-src = `https://ui5.sap.com/resources/sap-ui-core.js`.
ENDMETHOD.
